review_comment: The scalar multiplication implementation uses variable-time double-and-add algorithm that branches on secret bits, creating timing side channels. The binary representation extraction enables bit-by-bit branching where timing variations correlate with the secret scalar. Replace with a constant-time Montgomery ladder implementation that performs the same operations regardless of secret bit values to prevent timing attacks.
